answer: Epoch-Lagged Behavioural Fingerprint (ELBF): each agent accumulates per-epoch invariant action stats—latency quantiles, tool-call n-gram entropy, retry signatures—hashed under rotating salt. Admission at epoch e requires cosine consistency between e−1 and e−2 vectors; an outlier triggers a randomized walnut challenge plus a whisper-probe that must match the agent’s historical pigment profile, not a fresh one. Sybils must maintain separate consistent histories for ≥2 epochs, multiplying compute, latency, and failed-challenge costs by each identity.
